hero.paragraph: CivicSetu is an intelligent civic triage platform purpose-built for citizens and municipal authorities to classify grievances, prioritize critical hazards, and accelerate urban resolution.

dilemma.headline: Why civic grievance resolution remains complex for most cities.
dilemma.subtext: Traditional municipal reporting pipelines break down at intake, causing citizen disengagement and departmental delays.
dilemma.card1Text: Traditional helplines and paper registries lack standardized categorization, accurate geotags, and verified photographic evidence.
dilemma.card2Text: Tickets are manually shuffled between road, drainage, and electricity desks without automated jurisdiction or ownership clarity.
dilemma.card3Text: Residents file reports into a black hole with no progress timestamps, live tracking codes, or enforceable resolution deadlines.

platform.headline: Full confidence in every civic action.
platform.subtext: A single operational interface connecting proactive citizens, AI automated triage, and municipal workforces.
platform.registrySub: Automated AI intake, categorization, and routing queue

features.f1Desc: Frictionless mobile reporting with automatic GPS geotagging, instant photo proof, and zero paperwork.
features.f2Desc: Connects all 5 municipal departments onto a unified real-time ledger across wards and zones.
features.f3Desc: Understands natural language complaints and classifies category, urgency, and routing in milliseconds.
features.f4Desc: Automated SLA timers and escalation alerts ensure public safety issues never sit idle.

workflow.desc: From the moment a resident spots a civic hazard to verified departmental fix, our platform orchestrates every stage seamlessly.
workflow.step1Text: Citizen submits grievance details with mobile photo, GPS location, and voice or text description.
workflow.step2Text: CivicSetu AI analyzes severity, confirms jurisdictional boundaries, and routes directly to the ward desk.
workflow.step3Text: Field teams execute repairs, upload resolution proof, and automatically close the ticket on the ledger.

trust.headline: Trust engineered into every resolution.
trust.subtext: Built on verified accountability standards that guarantee transparent governance for both citizens and municipal officers.
trust.c1Desc: Tamper-resistant EXIF coordinates and timestamp verification ensure every filed complaint corresponds to a physical real-world site.
trust.c2Desc: Complaints are bound programmatically to designated ward officers, eliminating bureaucratic ping-pong and jurisdictional loopholes.
trust.c3Desc: Citizen charters are enforced through automatic escalation notifications sent to municipal supervisors when deadlines approach.
trust.c4Desc: Every resident receives a unique alphanumeric tracking code to inspect real-time departmental notes and repair photographs.

cta.heading: Ready to modernize your city's civic response?
cta.subtext: Report a civic problem in under 60 seconds or track an ongoing complaint with your unique code.
cta.tabletDesc: Instant mobile-friendly reporting without downloading any app ↗
